io.milvus.common.utils.cache

Class CollectionTsCache

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.common.utils.cache.CollectionTsCache

  • public class CollectionTsCache
extends Object
    In-process cache storing the latest session timestamp per endpoint, database, and collection. Timestamps are updated monotonically and can be invalidated or transferred on rename/alias.

      • copy

        public void copy(String endpoint,
                 String sourceDatabaseName,
                 String sourceCollectionName,
                 String targetDatabaseName,
                 String targetCollectionName)
        Copies the latest timestamp to an alias while retaining the collection key. The alias is updated monotonically so a newer timestamp recorded through the alias is not overwritten.
        Parameters:
        endpoint - the server endpoint
        sourceDatabaseName - the database of the source collection
        sourceCollectionName - the source collection name
        targetDatabaseName - the database of the target collection
        targetCollectionName - the target collection name
